use System.Random

toss() -> char => if random.next(2) == 0 then 'H' else 'T' fi

si

random_sequence() -> string => "{toss()}{toss()}{toss()}"

best_reply(sequence: string) -> string =>
    let flipped = if sequence[1] == 'H' then 'T' else 'H' fi in

        let sequence = line.trim().to_upper()
        write_line("> {sequence}")

        let valid =
            sequence.length == 3 /\
            sequence |> all(c => c == 'H' \/ c == 'T')

        if !valid then
            write_line("three tosses please, each H or T")
        elif sequence =~ taken then
            write_line("that one is taken")
        else
            return sequence
        fi
    od

    return null
si

let computer_wins mut = 0

while true do
    let computer_first = random.next(2) == 0

    let computer mut = ""

    if computer_first then
        computer = random_sequence()
        write_line("I choose {computer}. Your sequence?")
    else
        write_line("You choose first. Your sequence?")
    fi

    let player =
        ask_sequence(if computer_first then computer else null fi)

    if !player? then
        break
    fi

    if !computer_first then
        computer = best_reply(player)
        write_line("I choose {computer}")
    fi

        fi

        player_wins = player_wins + 1
        write_line("you win")
    else
        computer_wins = computer_wins + 1
        write_line("I win")
    fi

    write_line("you {player_wins}, me {computer_wins}")
    write_line()
od
